name: simonev-boyolali
description: SIMONEV Boyolali — Sistem Pemantauan Kinerja Indikator RPJMD. Monorepo: aplikasi Ops (operasional) + Eksekutif (dashboard pimpinan) + paket bersama.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w packages/schemas && npm run build -w apps/ops && npm run build -w apps/eksekutif
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/db && npm run typecheck -w packages/schemas && npm run typecheck -w apps/ops && npm run typecheck -w apps/eksekutif
